Tasha B: Quick one - I brought my partner on a client trip because flights were cheaper combined and we used the company card to hold both rooms during booking. Partner paid me back for their share by Venmo after. How do I split/report this? Also we had to pay for a last-minute babysitter one evening ($120) because a child care center closed. Can I expense that?
Jordan (People Ops): Two parts here. Companion travel/expenses: company policy does not cover partner/spouse travel or personal meals. If company card was used for companion items, employee must reimburse the company. Childcare: can be reimbursable in specific circumstances (pre-approved dependent care for business travel or emergency childcare with manager approval). Did you get pre-approval for the sitter?
Tasha B: No pre-approval, it was emergency same-day (center closed). I scanned the sitter receipt and Venmo proof (partner -> me) plus the hotel folio that shows two rooms charged. I asked Omar (my manager) and he said to ask People Ops / Finance to confirm.
Omar - Manager: I approve the emergency childcare reimbursement for Tasha. Manager note: "Omar approves emergency childcare due to center closure on 2026-07-14."
Finance Bot: Policy excerpt: Companion travel/expenses are not reimbursable. If company card was used for companion items (room, companion meals, companion incidentals), employee must reimburse the company the companion share with documentation (itemized folio or refund). For emergency dependent care: Finance may reimburse up to $200/day when manager approval is provided and receipts attached; requires a brief attestation and proof of business travel dates. Reimbursement for childcare is treated as a business expense, not taxable income to the employee when processed through expense (but local tax treatments may vary).
Travel Desk (Amelia): For future bookings, please book only business rooms on the company card or use 'split pay' when available. If partner must travel, either book separately on personal card or request travel desk assistance.
Tasha B: I uploaded: hotel_folio.pdf (shows two rooms, total $820), venmo_txn.png (partner paid me $210), sitter_receipt.pdf ($120), manager_approval.png. What's the exact workflow? Do I submit a reimbursement to the company for $210 or should Finance deduct from the company card charge?
Jordan (People Ops): Practical steps: 1) Create expense report with two line items: A) "Hotel - Company share" for the business room nights charged to company card (attach folio) and mark payment method Company Card; B) "Employee reimbursement - companion" for $210 (label "reimbursement to company for companion room") and mark payment method Personal Payment / Reimbursement. Do NOT create negative expense lines. 2) Attach Venmo proof, attestation: "I confirm my partner's share was $210 and was paid to me; request reimbursement to company card." 3) For the sitter: add a separate line "Emergency childcare - 2026-07-14" $120, attach receipt and manager approval.
Finance Bot: Automated guidance: we'll accept Venmo proof if accompanied by the hotel folio showing line items or a host invoice. If the folio does not split rooms, Finance will ask for a breakdown from the hotel or a signed employee attestation allocating the amounts. For childcare, since manager approval is attached, the $120 is eligible for reimbursement and will be processed as a standard expense. Processing note: companion reimbursements will be netted against the company card charge where possible; otherwise Finance will request a direct refund or manual repayment to the company card.
Tasha B: The folio lumps both rooms under one charge with room IDs but no per-room subtotal. Hotel told me they can issue a reissued folio with per-room breakdown if I request it. Should I ask them?
Travel Desk (Amelia): Yes please ask hotel for an itemized folio showing per-room charges and any incidentals per room. That speeds reconciliation. If they can't, the attestation plus Venmo proof is acceptable for amounts under $500, per Finance rules.
Tasha B: Hotel sent new folio with room A $410 and room B $410. Uploaded as hotel_folio_split.pdf. Updated expense: company share (one room) $410 on company card; companion reimbursement $210 (my partner paid me $210 which covered half of the second room plus minibar). How do I show the minibar split?
Jordan (People Ops): Add a short comment on the companion reimbursement line explaining the composition: "Companion reimbursement $210 = partial room + minibar $15" and attach the folio showing minibar line if present or note it in the attestation. If minibar was charged to company card and is companion-only, employee must reimburse that amount.
Finance Bot: Received updated docs. Automated check: companion reimbursement $210 < $500 threshold and attestation + venmo proof + split folio present. Flagged for expedited manual reconciliation. Childcare $120 with manager approval attached — eligible and will be processed. Expected timeline: companion reimbursement reconciliation ~3 business days; childcare payout ~2 business days.
Tasha B: Thanks. One last Q: do I need to declare the childcare reimbursement on my expense declaration form?
Jordan (People Ops): No extra declaration beyond the expense submission and attestation. Finance will handle any tax reporting if local rules require. Please include the manager approval screenshot and the sitter invoice.
Omar - Manager: Thanks for sorting quickly. Tasha, ping me if Finance asks for anything else and I'll confirm.
Tasha B: Uploaded attestation_signed.pdf and tagged report "companion-split-childcare-emergency". Thanks all :pray:
